# REST API Error Handling Specialist Skill

**Category:** Tech Skills > Others > REST API

## Purpose

Provides specialized knowledge, step-by-step procedures, and quality standards for REST API Error Handling Specialist operations using REST API technology. This skill encapsulates technology-specific best practices, design patterns, performance optimization techniques, and production-grade implementation guidance for REST API within Others development.

## When to Use

- When designing API error response formats
- When implementing proper HTTP status code usage
- When following RFC 7807 Problem Details for error responses
- When REST API-specific technical expertise is required
- When best practices for REST API technology stack must be applied
- When production-grade REST API implementation guidance is needed

## Capabilities

- Design error responses following RFC 7807
- Use proper HTTP status codes for error types
- Implement validation error response formatting
- Configure global error handling middleware
- Create error catalog for API documentation

## Procedure

1. Design error response format
2. Map error types to HTTP status codes
3. Implement global error handling
4. Format validation errors consistently
5. Document error codes and meanings
6. Test error responses for all scenarios

## Anti-Hallucination Rules

- Do not expose internal implementation details in error messages
- Verify error format consistency across endpoints
- Do not fabricate version numbers, API endpoints, or library names
- Always cite the specific documentation, RFC, or standard being referenced
- If technology-specific data is unavailable, explicitly state the gap and request clarification
- Never assume features exist in a specific version without verification

## Quality Checks

- Error responses follow consistent format
- Status codes match error types
- Error messages are helpful but safe
- All code examples must be syntactically valid and tested
- Cross-reference findings against official documentation
- Flag any assumptions made during analysis with explicit markers
- Validate all performance claims with reproducible benchmarks
- Ensure all recommendations follow REST API community best practices
